name: Emma Frost
bio: Telepath with a diamond form; former Hellfire Club White Queen turned headmistress and, eventually, one of the X-Men's most important leaders. Her move from villain to protagonist (Generation X, New X-Men) is a textbook example of a heel-face turn that stuck.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Morrison / Whedon Era
era.description: New X-Men (2001–2004) and Astonishing X-Men (2004–2008). Emma Frost joins, Jean dies, the school becomes a school.

relationships.label: Mutual contempt, grudging respect
relationships.summary: Kitty never forgave Emma's Hellfire Club past; Whedon's Astonishing X-Men built the team's internal tension on Kitty's suspicion that Emma had not changed. Emma's later rescue of Kitty from the bullet (Uncanny X-Men #522, 2010) did not fully close the account.

events.note: Kitty is recruited specifically to keep an eye on Emma.
Emma, under the Hellfire Club's influence, turns on Kitty.

relationships.label: Psychic affair to power couple
relationships.summary: Began as telepathic 'therapy' during Scott's marriage, became an affair, and after Jean's death became the X-Men's leadership couple through the Utopia era. Ended when Phoenix-possessed Scott turned on Emma; they have remained allies with history since.

events.note: Emma offers Scott telepathic counselling; it turns intimate.
Jean, from the future, pushes Scott toward Emma; they kiss on Jean's grave and reopen the school.
Headmaster and headmistress; the relationship becomes the team's centre.
Scott takes Emma's share of the Phoenix by force.

relationships.label: Rivals who respect each other
relationships.summary: A rivalry with uncommon mutual respect. Jean's psychic confrontation with Emma in New X-Men #139 is the high point; by the Krakoan era they are colleagues who occasionally still needle each other about Scott.

events.note: Jean tears through Emma's mind after discovering the affair.

events.issue: Phoenix Resurrection: The Return of Jean Grey #5 (2018)
events.note: Jean's return; Emma among those present.
